# 🏠 ClifHouse ### *Live AI House Above the Ocean*
[![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.10+-3776AB?style=for-the-badge&logo=python&logoColor=white)](https://python.org) [![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-009688?style=for-the-badge&logo=fastapi&logoColor=white)](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com) [![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React_18-61DAFB?style=for-the-badge&logo=react&logoColor=black)](https://react.dev) [![Vite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-646CFF?style=for-the-badge&logo=vite&logoColor=white)](https://vitejs.dev) [![WebSocket](https://img.shields.io/badge/WebSocket-Live-FF6B6B?style=for-the-badge&logo=socketdotio&logoColor=white)](#)

> *"What if AI agents felt like people you **watch**, not prompts you **send**?"*
--- ## 🌊 What is ClifHouse? **ClifHouse** is a real‑time AI reality show: **9 simulated humans** living in a cliffside house, constantly making decisions, reacting to real news, texting each other, and posting to social feeds — all powered by live LLM calls.
### 🎬 A narrative experience A cozy, cinematic "always‑on" show about found family. Watch AI residents live their lives, form relationships, react to the world, and create moments you didn't script. ### 🏗️ A reference architecture How to build **multi‑agent, real‑time, LLM‑driven worlds** with a modern web UI. Fork it, extend it, make it yours.
--- ## 🏡 The House — Isometric View

🎮 Isometric rendering — office, kitchen, living room, bedrooms, garage, rooftop, pool & beach

--- ## ⚙️ Architecture

🧠 Multi-agent orchestration — LLM brains → Agent personas → Real-time WebSocket → Canvas UI

📂 Full Project Structure (click to expand)
``` backend/ ├── agents/ │ ├── characters.py # Agent profiles, personalities, pinboard topics │ ├── nvidia_client.py # NVIDIA NIM client (rate-limited chat completions) │ └── groq_client.py # Groq client (actions, narration, pinboard, Dzups, messages) ├── orchestrator/ │ └── world.py # WorldOrchestrator: simulation loop & scheduling ├── models/ │ └── schemas.py # Pydantic models for world state └── api/ └── server.py # FastAPI + WebSocket + SPA static serving frontend/ ├── index.html ├── src/ │ ├── main.jsx # React entry │ ├── App.jsx # Root layout / composition │ ├── hooks/ │ │ └── useWorld.js # WebSocket connection + demo fallback │ ├── components/ │ │ ├── SceneCanvas.jsx # 60fps isometric house & characters (canvas) │ │ ├── LeftPanel.jsx # Roster: energy, emotion, location, speech │ │ ├── RightPanel.jsx # Story / Chat / Pinboard / Dzups tabs │ │ ├── Popups.jsx # Phone popup, Dzups toast │ │ └── TypeWriter.jsx # Human-speed typewriter effect │ └── styles/ │ └── global.css # Layout + animations ```
--- ## 🔄 How the Simulation Works
```mermaid graph LR A[🕐 Clock Tick] --> B[⚡ 1s real = 2min sim] B --> C{Agent Loop} C --> D[🚶 Movement & Sleep] C --> E[🤖 Action Decisions] C --> F[📌 Pinboard Posts] C --> G[📱 Dzups Feed] C --> H[💬 Private Texts] C --> I[📖 Narration] C --> J[🎉 Group Events] D & E & F & G & H & I & J --> K[📡 WebSocket Broadcast] K --> L[🖥️ React + Canvas UI] style A fill:#FF6B6B,color:#fff style K fill:#4ECDC4,color:#fff style L fill:#61DAFB,color:#000 ```
### 🧠 Backend — `WorldOrchestrator`
🕐 Clock System - `1 real second → 2 simulated minutes` - Tracks `current_time`, `is_night`, `day_number`, `weather`, `house_mood`
🚶 Movement & Sleep - Each tick moves agents smoothly toward `target_x, target_y` - Per‑agent sleep windows between ~22:00–01:00 and wake between ~05:00–09:00 - Sleeping agents auto‑move to bedrooms and recharge energy; awake agents slowly drain energy
🤖 Action Decisions (Groq) - Roughly every 45s per agent (staggered) - Sends time, energy, weather, nearby agents, and recent narration to Groq - Returns JSON: `location`, `emotion`, `activity`, `speech`, `energy_delta` - Orchestrator updates locations, feelings, activities, speech bubbles, and energy
📌 Pinboard (Real-World News) - About every 15 simulated minutes per agent - Chooses an awake agent that is "due" to post - Groq writes a short pinboard update grounded in real recent events - Categories: `ai`, `trading`, `racing`, `medical`, `art`, `business`, `creative`, `trending`, `legal`
📱 Dzups Social Feed - About every 10 simulated minutes per agent (with jitter) - Post types: `photo`, `feeling`, `poll`, `opinion`, `bts`, `promo` - Groq generates voice‑accurate captions - Posts include likes, location tags, and accent colors
💬 Private Texts & 📖 Narration - **Texts**: Every 30 ticks — picks two awake agents, Groq writes in‑character texts - **Narration**: Periodically creates cinematic one‑liner narration - Tones: `neutral` / `drama` / `funny` / `sad` / `romantic` / `united` / `scary`
🎉 Group Events Events include: bonfire, movie night, rooftop session, horse incident, storm watch, late‑night kitchen, pool chaos - Moves 4–7 participants to the event location - Sets `active_event` and generates event narration
### 🎨 Frontend | Component | Role | |-----------|------| | **`useWorld`** | WebSocket hook → live data or demo fallback | | **`SceneCanvas`** | 60fps canvas isometric renderer — sky, ocean, cliffs, rooms, characters | | **`LeftPanel`** | Clock, weather, mood, resident roster with live stats | | **`RightPanel`** | 4 tabs — **STORY** · **CHAT** · **BOARD** · **DZUPS** | | **`Popups`** | Phone popup for texts, cinematic toast for new Dzups posts | | **`TypeWriter`** | Human‑speed typewriter animation for narrative text | --- ## 🛠️ Tech Stack

--- ## 🚀 Getting Started ### 1️⃣ Install Python dependencies ```bash cd clifhouse python -m venv .venv source .venv/bin/activate # Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate pip install -r requirements.txt ``` ### 2️⃣ Add your API keys *(optional but recommended)* ```bash cp .env.example .env # Edit .env and set: # NVIDIA_API_KEY=nvapi-... (get a free key at build.nvidia.com) # GROQ_API_KEY=gsk_... (get a free key at console.groq.com) ``` > [!TIP] > **With keys** → agents, pinboard, Dzups, texts, and narration are live and grounded in current events. > > **Without keys** → the app runs in **demo mode** with pre‑seeded content; all UI and visuals still work. ### 3️⃣ Build frontend and run ```bash cd frontend npm install npm run build cd .. python main.py # 🌐 Open http://localhost:8000 ``` ### 🔥 Dev mode (hot‑reload frontend) ```bash # Terminal 1 – backend python main.py # Terminal 2 – frontend cd frontend npm run dev # 🌐 Open http://localhost:5173 ``` --- ## 🔑 Environment Variables | Variable | Used By | Purpose | |----------|---------|---------| | `GROQ_API_KEY` | `groq_client.py` | Pinboard, narration, texts, Dzups, action decisions | | `NVIDIA_API_KEY` | `nvidia_client.py` | Chat completions via NVIDIA NIM (rate‑limited) | | `PORT` | `server.py` | HTTP/WebSocket port (default: `8000`) | --- ## 🧩 Extending the World
👤 Add new residents Define them in backend/agents/characters.py and include them in AGENT_ORDER
🎬 New world events Edit _trigger_group_event in backend/orchestrator/world.py
📅 Richer schedules Tweak sleep and activity logic for weekday/weekend or "tour day" patterns
📱 Alternate clients Build mobile/VR or analytics dashboards on top of the JSON WorldState
